facts.fact: Working holiday visa holders apply online for a TFN only when located in Australia with a valid work rights visa (417 and 462 listed). Page updated 22 June 2026.
No documents need to be sent; the visa linked to the passport is the eligibility basis.
TFN should be received within 28 days of the ATO receiving the completed application, posted to the Australian postal address on the application.
Do not lodge another application during the 28 days (it can delay processing); after 28 days contact the ATO with the ATO receipt ID.
Applying for a TFN is free.
An employee who has applied for a TFN has 28 days to provide it; employer withholds at the top rate if no TFN, no exemption and no advice that the employee applied, or if still no TFN after 28 days.
No-TFN withholding for a working holiday maker: 45%. WHM rate 15% on the first $45,000 from 1 July 2026; no tax-free threshold.
Superannuation Guarantee 12% of ordinary time earnings.
ATO phone 13 28 61 (business hours), +61 2 6216 1111 from overseas; TFN issued once and kept for life; most WHMs receive it in two to four weeks.

Approved Italian compliance sentences already on the site: 'Working Holiday Tax opera sotto la supervisione di un agente fiscale registrato' and 'Rivista e approvata da un agente fiscale registrato prima di essere presentata all’ATO'.
